import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T + p[3]/eps + p[4]*T**0.6265/eps + p[5]*np.sqrt(eps)*T**2.9308
            + p[6]*L*T**3.9308/eps + p[7]*eps*T**2.863 + p[8]*L*T**2 + p[9]*T**2)
